title: Lenovo Thinksmart Core NUC: Intel i5 1145G7E CPU, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD $399 + Delivery @ Hub by Triforce
body:
Deal: Lenovo Thinksmart Core NUC: Intel i5 1145G7E CPU, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD $399 + Delivery @ Hub by Triforce

[bonezAU] Almost worth it for the RAM and NVMe alone at current prices
[Team Triforce] Unfortunately the RAM is soldered on-board.
[Hank Scorpion] Or fortunately for people who want to buy this otherwise it might be worth a lot more. The CPU isn't much of a powerhouse though, these were designed to run teams rooms.
[Scomo On Smoko] CPU: i5-1145G7E - Released: Q3'2020
Shipping $10 to Vic
Warranty: 3-year Premier Support: Really?
Not a Bad deal if it has the warranty.
[joedante] I mean, it's an Embedded though.
Good for power efficiency but not going to match an i5 8500 for performance.
[bargaino] Idle power and performance are not terribly different. But the newer 11th gen will be better for AI or video purposes. e.g. Frigate or Jellyfin.
[OMG] You can buy it from eBay for the same price (you may buy discount gift card) with free shipping.
[M00Cow] CPU does.well against similar priced Ryzen 5 3500u
https://www.cpubenchmark.net/compare/4396vs6304vs3421/Intel-…
[Fuzor] Maybe stupid question, but how do you upgrade the graphics in this?
[Agret] The computer has a USB-C (Thunderbolt™ 4) connector that you should be able to use to connect an external GPU enclosure.
You'd then plug your display directly into the GPU through that enclosure.
[bri11iant-y] There's no TB4 port according to their listing
Ports & Slots
• USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 (for Controller)
• USB-A 3.2 Gen 1
• HDMI out
• USB-A 3.2 Gen 2
• RJ45 ethernet
• USB-C 3.2 Gen 2
• USB-A 3.2 Gen 2
• HDMI out
• Power in
• Optional: HDMI in
which is porbably copied from
https://www.lenovo.com/au/en/p/vr-smartdevices/smart-office/…
[Tacooo] Follow the link for details!
Or you could just put them in the title or body.
[stratbargain] W11 IOT LTSC out of the box is a huge win. So much better than mainstream w11
[joedante] I've never tried it. What makes it better?
[joedante] So what is removed? Does it impact running it as a desktop?
[boozed] @joedante: I forgot to add that it also has guaranteed updates for longer than regular LTSC editions.
It's fine to use as a desktop, it just comes without Microsoft Store apps which can be added back in later if you really need them (e.g. by using Winhance).
[joedante] @boozed: Thankyou. Sounds like a better version of the N variant.
[Agret] @boozed: As these devices are setup as conferencing ones you will have to do a full reinstall of Windows 11 IoT as by default it won't actually boot to the Windows desktop.
[bri11iant-y] It's a heavily modified OS tho, I have a similar MS Team conferencing kit from HP, it takes you straight to MS Team on login
[Hornpub] that worth a lot actually LTSC license probably cost more than the machine
[lonewolf] Umart seems to have had the same model ? but out of stock. If the price is accurate then umart sold it for $299?
https://www.umart.com.au/corporate/product/lenovo-thinksmart…
[DadBangr] Would this play Minecraft for my 9 year old?
[SnowDragon] Yes. You could probably even run a heavily modded server on it for 16 players easily.
[pinopio] Used 8GB version was available on ebay a couple of months ago for $250 shipped.
https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/336433680411
Seller offered me a 10% discount, making it quite tempting, but I decided to give it a pass because the RAM isn't upgradeable. Wasn't that much stock so I didn't make a post, but thought I'd mention it as a price reference.
[Agret] Good call, 8GB RAM is not really enough for the modern Windows 11 versions.
[OMG] Can this be used as a home web server with a PostgreSQL database + a lightweight .Net website?
[bonezAU] Yes, and probably be sitting at 1-2% CPU usage the whole time. You could do a lot more with these as a home server than run a database and lightweight website. Providing that website wasn't getting smashed by visitors, of course.
[Wonderfool] If you need to ask, then yes it's enough.
Database optimisation and load balancing is probably a few years further down your home lab/ IT journey.
[joshx] more than enough. but that's how it starts, i'm warning you. :-)
[rigram] Overpriced umart previously had it for $299
[Wonderfool] Is there any reason to get this over 8500 second hand ssf? I think it's about 20% improvement in IPC? Anything else?
The 12th gen is quite a long time to drop to reasonable price, so starting to lose patience lol
[S Baldrick] Onboard GPU is probably much more capable
[coxymla] 18% IPC over Skylake, more cache, 10nm process shrink, much better GPU.
[Wonderfool] If there's no expectation to expand storage, yes. If you need more space, better to just get a former office PC with sata and pcie ports.
[3dprintdeals] Optiplex micro 7090 is this price and probably more versatile, with upgradable ram and storage
[Agret] I found the driver download page
https://smartsupport.lenovo.com/us/en/products/smart/smart-c…
And the hardware maintenance manual
https://download.lenovo.com/consumer/iot/thinksmart_core_ip_…
If you click onto the Enterprise Management section you can download all of the drivers in a single zip for either Windows 10 or Windows 11
[Agret] Only with external thunderbolt4 GPU Enclosure.
[Erwark] Crysis will run on absolute garbage with 256 MB VRAM, it will just be awfully slow.
[internet-stranger] Yes. Almost every computer is, at least part of it.
[Erwark] You are in luck - they are hand-crafted by artisans in the south of France.
[Team Triforce] Confirmed, designed & assembled in France!
[tabletop12] Are these good for Jellyfin home servers?
[adventurer] With the port cover/cable management thing and USB ports at the back. this will be damn irritating to use as a daily PC.
[Orrelljet] Is it not possible to remove the decor/cable covers?
[adventurer] The picture shows the cover rotate upwards.
You can hack it off of course, just won't be pretty.
[circit] I'm confused if it does or doesn't come with the console screen thing?
like is core mean just the core unit or is core the platform?
the really interesting use case is if the optional hdmi in is included and works for capture, this would be a good streaming pc.
and power wise it would beat my 2700x for hosting game servers, pity about the ram thou.
[Team Triforce] Just the unit, it’s advertised as the NUC not the room kit.
[bri11iant-y] Be aware it might comes a heavily modified OS, which takes you straight to a special version of MS Teams on login.
You will need to reintall OS of your choice or have the knowledge to remove the scripts and automations that open MS Teams
[henestto] Does anyone know if this machine can be reinstalled with a normal Windows 11 Pro licence, and is the BIOS unrestricted? Planning to use as a light home desktop with old large TV's.
[bri11iant-y] You can install any OS you want if there is no BIOS password/lock
[mjae01] Will make a cracking Plex server. Supports hdr tone mapping and av1 transcoding :)
[idonotknowwhy] How was this ever $999? Nobody in their right mind would have paid that.
[henestto] Does this ThinkSmart Core have a transferable Windows 11 Pro licence or OEM Windows licence that allows Windows 11 Pro to be installed and activated? Or is the only Windows licence supplied with the machine Windows 11 IoT Enterprise? Want to take into account the possible extra cost to use this as a light home desktop.
[Team Triforce] Ships with W11 IOT, W11 Pro is something you’d need to organise yourself.
